case_title: MGM''S CABINET INSTALLATION SERVICE VS. WINNIE BRIDGES

docket_entries.description: SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF DEC-07-2018 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT CROSS COMPLAINANT BRIDGES, WINNIE RECOVER FROM CROSS DEFENDANT MGM'S CABINET INSTALLATION SERVICE $7,580.00 PRINCIPAL, $191.75 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $7,771.75, PLAINTIFF SHALL PAY DEFENDANT: $7580 FOR THE REASONS STATED IN THE ATTACHED MEMORANDUM.
